3.content: The second: He spread about the one who had rebelled, he crucified

spiritual_reading:
# The Seven Works of Divine Truth in Regener ation

** ¶1. ** Divine Truth proceeding from the Lord has accomplished seven complete works of regeneration through its own omn ipotence.

**¶2.** The first : It raised the original celestial will — the good of innocence that had descended into spiritual temptation — back out of that combat , in the way a precious interior truth is recovered from the vast obsc urity of the natural mind.

** ¶3.** The second: It exposed the ruling self-love that had risen against divine order, and fixed it — rendered it powerless — in every particular of the external life , so that it could no longer move freely but was fast ened and held in subj ection throughout the whole natural person .

**¶4.** The third: It subj ugated, confined , and penetrated the in most falsities and evils that belong to spiritual death, so that their essential power was broken apart .

**¶5.** The fourth: It formed doc trinal vessels of understanding — containing forms made from wisdom — through which divine truth could be carried and conveyed across every region of the mind .

**¶6.** The fifth: It called forth its five fac ulties of spiritual perception and arranged them throughout the whole organized sphere of the regener ating mind. These fac ulties took possession of that sphere ; they bore the entire weight of the natural order beneath them. Furthermore , it called forth three essential divine truths, and set them within three recept ive forms at three distinct degrees — and another upon the dominant natural power. And again, it sent forth the interior calling, so that it might be united with the five illumin ated per ceptions, awak ening them from within .

**¶7.** The sixth: When it had constructed the ordered spiritual sphere, it arose and sent forth a multitude of particular goods and particular tru ths, so that they would establish firm boundaries around the circuit of that sphere on every side — gu arding its arrangement — until the whole work of spiritual formation was complete. And when all the works were finished, it gathered some of these goods and truths into the interior repositories of the mind , and it stationed others at posts of vigilance, where they would keep perpet ual watch against the infl ux of evil and fals ity.

**¶8. ** The seventh: At the time when Divine Love displayed the rad iance of the Divine Human form, Divine Truth established many interior goods and truths in their permanent stations . They took hold of that form , so that the entire spiritual structure would not collapse — so that the ev ils would not turn against one another in opposition to the wisdom that had been impl anted throughout .

* Note: The damaged portions of this paragraph resist full translation; the best reading is that the revelation of the Divine Human form is what finally stabil izes the entire interior architecture , preventing the remaining hered itary evils from consp iring against the light of wisdom now dwelling within.*

** ¶9.** And there is yet another great and glorious work that Divine Truth will accomplish at the cons ummation: it is the final glor ified form of the whole spiritual person — the completed human image — which it will raise into the heav enly states of eternal wisdom. And it enters in , and it takes hold of what remains , and it strikes down the last resistance , and it builds the form that end ures forever , and it g athers all things into unity .

* This final " statue " or form corresponds to what Swedenborg calls the complete regener ation — the moment when the interior and exterior person are fully unified, and the whole human being , in glor ified spiritual form, is elevated permanently into heaven .*
